_note: DRAFT Wolof (Senegal, CLAD orthography). Drafted from the Peace Corps Dakar 1970 course and the Wolof-English phrasebook on the drive plus standard modern Wolof. Loanwords from French/English kept where that is what aides actually say in Dakar (sertifikaa, doktor, lopitaal, infirmiyeer). MUST be reviewed by a native speaker before it is treated as final.

hv_001.term_wo: Aide à domicile (ku di topptoo nit ci këram)
hv_001.definition_wo: Liggéeykat bu jàng, di topptoo nit ñi ci seen kër: sang leen, sol leen, lekkal leen, te di ko def ci kaw kilifteefu infirmiyeer.

hv_002.definition_wo: Kayit bi ekib bi bind, di wone li nga war a def, li ñu bëgg a àgg ak li nga war a seetlu. Am na kopi ci kër kiliyaan bi.

hv_003.definition_wo: Ku ci ekib bi di saytu palaŋu topptoo bi ak sarwiis yi.

hv_004.definition_wo: Infirmiyeer bu ñëw ci kër gi, leeral palaŋ bi, jàngal la doxalin yi, saafara jafe-jafe yi te di xool sa liggéey.

hv_005.definition_wo: Sa wareef: gis ak sa bët, sa bakkan, sa nopp ak sa loxo lu soppiku ; bind rekk li nga gis ak li nga def, ak bés bi ak sa turu ; wax ko infirmiyeer bi.

hv_006.definition_wo: Bul wax kenn mbirum kiliyaan bi, du ci waxtaan, du ci kayit. Yoon bu ñuy wax HIPAA moo ko aar.

hv_007.definition_wo: Yoonu réewum Amerig bu aar xibaar yi aju ci wérgi-yaramu nit.

hv_008.term_wo: Soxla yi gën a am solo ci nit
hv_008.definition_wo: Soxlay yaram, kaaraange, bokk ci mbokk yi, teggin ak jàmm ci sa bopp. Yaram ak kaaraange ñoo jëkk.

hv_009.term_wo: Jëflante bu baax ak kiliyaan bi
hv_009.definition_wo: Jëflante bu ñu waajal, am njariñ te sukkandiku ci kóolute ; di weg sañ-sañu kiliyaan bi te di ko may mu def li mu mën.

hv_010.definition_wo: Sañ-sañu kiliyaan bi di dogal ci boppam lu jëm ci dundam ak toppatoom.

hv_011.definition_wo: Déglu ak sa xol bépp, bàyyi nit ki mu wax ba pare, te wone ne nand nga.

hv_012.definition_wo: Jafe-jafe ci wax walla nand làkk, gën a am ginnaaw AVC. Du jafe-jafe ci dégg.

hv_013.definition_wo: Jafe-jafe ci fàttaliku, xalaat walla nand.

hv_014.term_wo: Laago bu jóge ci ndaw (handicap du développement)
hv_014.definition_wo: Laago bu dul wéy, bu tàmbali laata 22 at (paralysie cérébrale, autisme, laago ci xel).

hv_015.definition_wo: Li nit di def bés bu nekk ngir boppam : sangu, sol, lekk, dem wanag, dox ak jóge fenn dem feneen.

hv_016.term_wo: Nutriman yi (li yaram soxla ci ñam)
hv_016.definition_wo: Li yaram soxla ci ñam : proteyin, glisid (sukar ak féculents), diw, witamin, mineero ak ndox.

hv_017.definition_wo: Régime bu doktor santaane, di soppi benn nutriman, kalori yi walla ni ñam wi mel.

hv_018.definition_wo: Régime bu wàññi xorom : jàng etiket yi, bàyyi ñam yu ñu jaay yu pare, bul dolli xorom ci togg wi walla ci palaat bi.

hv_019.term_wo: Régime bu amul lu metti biir
hv_019.definition_wo: Régime bu amul poobar, épis, sangara ak kafe, ndax dañuy metti biir.

hv_020.definition_wo: Ñam bu ñu dagg, mool walla nos ngir ñi mënul a ñàmm walla wann. Nosal ñam bu nekk moom rekk.

hv_021.definition_wo: Jafe-jafe ci wann. Dafa soxla ñam yu ñu soppi ak ndox yu ñu baxal ngir ñam wi dul jëm ci pumoŋ yi.

hv_022.term_wo: Fausse route (ñam wi dem ci pumoŋ)
hv_022.definition_wo: Ñam walla ndox mu dem ci pumoŋ yi, du ci biir. Mën na indi pnemoni.

hv_023.definition_wo: Jëfandikoo sa yaram bu baax ngir bañ a gaañu : tànk yi xàjj, lemal óom ak jur, yor li nga yor ci sa yaram, jadd ak sa tànk, bul wëlbati sa ndigg.

hv_024.term_wo: Aar ci wàllu jàngoro (contrôle des infections)
hv_024.definition_wo: Lépp lu ñuy def ngir mikrob yi bañ a tas : raxas loxo, gant, xàjjale lu set ak lu tilim, sànni mbalit mi bu baax.

hv_025.definition_wo: Jéego yi jàngoro di jaar ngir jóge ci kenn dem ci keneen. Boo dogee benn jéego, jàngoro ji taxaw.

hv_026.definition_wo: Li nga war a def ak kiliyaan bu nekk : raxas loxo, gant ak yeneen aar, yor bu baax lu ñaw ak dereet ak yeneen ndox yu yaram.

hv_027.definition_wo: Gant, blus, mask ak aar bët, ngir aar sa bopp ci jàngoro.

hv_028.definition_wo: Mikrob yu nekk ci dereet : hépatite B, hépatite C ak VIH (SIDA).

hv_029.definition_wo: Sa dér, sa bët, sa gémmiñ walla sa gaañu-gaañu laal dereet walla ndoxum yaramu kiliyaan bi. Raxas ko, wax ko ci saa si, topp yoonu agence bi.

hv_030.term_wo: Escarre (gaañu-gaañu ci dér ndax toog bu yàgg)
hv_030.definition_wo: Dér bi yàqu ndax toog walla tëdd bu yàgg ci benn béréb : coccyx, tànk yi, sacrum, hanche yi, óom yi, ginnaawu bopp. Firnde yu jëkk : xonq, tàng, démangeaison.

hv_031.term_wo: Béréb yi gën a yàqu (points de pression)
hv_031.definition_wo: Béréb yu yax yi ñëw ci dér bi : coccyx, tànk yi, sacrum, ischions, ginnaawu bopp, óom yi.

hv_032.definition_wo: Toog ci lal bi, boppu lal bi yékkatiku. Dafay yombal noyyi ak lekk.

hv_033.term_wo: Tëdd ci ginnaaw / ci biir / ci wet
hv_033.definition_wo: Tëdd ci sa ginnaaw / ci sa biir / ci sa wet.

hv_034.term_wo: Transfert (jële nit fenn yóbbu ko feneen)
hv_034.definition_wo: Jële kiliyaan bi ci lal bi yóbbu ko ci siis bi walla fauteuil bi. Tëj fren yi bu jëkk.

hv_035.definition_wo: Dox. Taxaw ci wetu kiliyaan bi gu wóorul, ndank-ndank, ci yoon wu gàtt.

hv_036.definition_wo: Yëngal cér bu nekk ba fa mu mën a àgg. Bu kiliyaan bi ko defee boppam : actif ; boo ko defalee : passif.

hv_037.definition_wo: Sidit walla cér bu dëgër ba du yëngu, ndax yàgg na yëngu.

hv_038.definition_wo: Sidit yi di wàññiku ndax yàgg nañu liggéey.

hv_039.definition_wo: Jumtukaay ngir dem wanag ci lal bi. Tàngal bassin bi, aar sutura, jox kayitu wanag ak sonet.

hv_040.definition_wo: Siis bu am wanag, ñu teg ko ci wetu lal bi.

hv_041.term_wo: Mënul a téye saw walla biir (incontinence)
hv_041.definition_wo: Mënul a téye saw walla jàpp biir. Aar teggin bi, soppi kuus bi bu gaaw, topptoo dér bi, bul ko yedd mukk.

hv_042.definition_wo: Tiyo bu jaar ci biir ngir génne saw. Am na bu dëkk ci biir, am na bu ñu teg ci kaw (étui pénien).

hv_043.definition_wo: Saak bi di dajale saw mi jóge ci sonde bi. Na nekk ci suuf, gën a suufe wet gi ; wax ko bu saw mi tilimee, am dereet walla néewee lool.

hv_044.term_wo: Li mu naan ak li mu saw (apports et éliminations)
hv_044.definition_wo: Natt lépp lu kiliyaan bi naan ak lépp lu mu saw.

hv_045.definition_wo: Amul bëñ. Fomp gémmiñ gi ak gum yi ak coton bu tooy.

hv_046.definition_wo: Bëñ yu ñu mën a summi. Raxas leen ci kaw lavabo bu ñu teg ci serwiyet ; denc leen ci ndox.

hv_047.term_wo: Kawas yu ñu ñeg (bas de contention)
hv_047.definition_wo: Kawas yu dëgër yuy dimbali dereet ji dox ci tànk yi. Sol leen ginnaaw bu tànk yi yékkatikoo, bañ a am ñiir.

hv_048.definition_wo: Masin bu am saak ngir yékkati kiliyaan bu mënul taxaw. Seet lépp lu ñu takk laata ngay yëngal.

hv_049.definition_wo: Palaŋ bu rëy bu ñu teg diggante lal bi ak siis bi ngir kiliyaan bi wàcc. Siis bi ci 45 degre.

hv_050.definition_wo: Ceinture bu yaatu ñu takk ci ndiggu kiliyaan bi ngir nga mën koo jàpp bu wóor boo koy yëngal walla dox ak moom.

hv_051.definition_wo: Cér walla jumtukaay bu ñu defar : loxo walla tànk, bët, wéer, aparey nopp, lunet, bëñu lëmm.

hv_052.definition_wo: Nit ki ñu war, garab bi ñu war, dose bi ñu war, waxtu wi ñu war, yoon wi ñu war. Seet bu nekk ci etiket bi ak ci palaŋu topptoo bi.

hv_053.term_wo: Dimbali kiliyaan bi mu jël garabam moom ci boppam
hv_053.definition_wo: Fàttali ko, indil ko garab bi, jàngal ko etiket bi, ubbil ko boyet bi, jox ko ndox, ba mu jël garab bi moom ci boppam. Doo ko jox garab mukk.

hv_054.definition_wo: Ni ñuy jël garab bi : ci gémmiñ, ci dér, ci bët, añs.

hv_055.definition_wo: Bés bi garab walla ñam warul a jàll.

hv_056.definition_wo: Lor nit ci teyé : ci yaram, ci xol, ci sëy walla ci xaalis. Dañu ko war a wax.

hv_057.definition_wo: Bañ a jox nit li mu soxla : ñam, ndox, set, kaaraange walla topptoo. Dañu ko war a wax itam.

hv_058.term_wo: Ku yoon wi sant mu wax (mandatory reporter)
hv_058.definition_wo: Liggéeykat bu yoon wi sant mu wax bépp toroxal walla bàyyi nit bu mu gis.

hv_059.term_wo: Directives anticipées (li nit bëgg ci faju bu mënatul wax)
hv_059.definition_wo: Kayitu yoon bu wone li nit bëgg ci toppatoom bu mënatul wax boppam (testament de vie, ku ñu dénk).

hv_060.definition_wo: Santaaneb doktor ñu bañ a def réanimation bu xol bi walla noyyi bi taxawee.

hv_061.definition_wo: Rescue : génne kiliyaan bi ak yaw. Alarm : woo 911. Confine : tëj bunt yi. Extinguish/Evacuate : fey walla génn. Ndigël yi bu am taal.

hv_062.definition_wo: Airway (yoonu noyyi), Breathing (noyyi), Circulation (dereet) : li nga war a seet bu jëkk bu am urgence.

hv_063.definition_wo: Sukar bu wàcc ci dereet : ñaq, lox, jaxasoo, bopp buy wër. Jox ko sukar bu gaaw bu xamee boppam, ba pare wax ko.

hv_064.definition_wo: Ñàkk fàttaliku, xalaat ak jëflante ba du mën a dund bu baax. Alzheimer mooy gën a bari.

hv_065.term_wo: Li nga sañ a def (champ de pratique)
hv_065.definition_wo: Liggéey yi yoon wi may la. Aide à domicile du jox garab, du def pansement stérile, du dogal mbirum faju.

hv_067.definition_wo: Raxas béréb yi ci diggante tànk yi. Def ko mujj ci sangu ci lal bi, ci kanam jëm ginnaaw.

hv_068.term_wo: Lal bu nit nekk ci kaw (lit occupé)
hv_068.definition_wo: Soppi dara yi te kiliyaan bi nekk ci lal bi, di sotti dara bu tilim bi ci suufu kiliyaan bi.

hv_069.definition_wo: Wax kiliyaan bu gumba fan la ñam wi nekk ci palaat bi ni waxtu yi ci montar.

hv_070.definition_wo: Yoon yi agence bi tëral te nga war a topp : incident, xaalis, bu nga ñëwul, ak li nga war a wax.
